title: Eliminate masked proof debt surfaced by 9efd9c39 code review
description:
## Context

Code review on 9efd9c39 (`run_id e58a259e`, 2026-05-15) surfaced three concrete proof-debt items that the passing `lake-build` gate does not catch. The reviewer issued PASS on 9efd9c39 because the items are pre-existing and out of that issue's stated scope, but flagged them as load-bearing for any future claim that QuadraticExt / CubicExt are formally verified.

## Problems

### Problem 1 — three `sorry`-backed `@[progress]` lemmas mask inversion correctness

`proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ExtProgress.lean` ends three theorems with `sorry`:

| Line | Theorem | `@[progress]`? | Downstream consumer |
|------|---------|----------------|---------------------|
| `:105` | `qinv_closure_progress` | no  | required by `qinv_progress` proof |
| `:115` | `qinv_progress`         | yes | `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/QuadraticExtField.lean:86` (`inv_correct`) |
| `:219` | `cinv_progress`         | yes | `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/CubicExtField.lean:95` (`inv_correct`) |

Because `qinv_progress` and `cinv_progress` carry `@[progress]`, the Aeneas `progress` tactic silently discharges any inversion goal against the unverified specs. The headline `inv_correct` theorems in `QuadraticExtField.lean` and `CubicExtField.lean` therefore look proven but bottom out in `sorry`. **The QuadraticExt / CubicExt inversion correctness contracts are not actually established.**

### Problem 2 — `lake build` does not reject `sorry`s in the proof tree

`proofs/lakefile.lean` does not turn the `sorry` warning into an error for the project's `lean_lib`s (`Gf2Core`, `Gf2Algebra`). Consequence: the `lake-build` gate passes against any number of `sorry`s in hand-written proofs, so masked proof debt of the kind in Problem 1 cannot be caught by the gate alone.

### Problem 3 — stale narrative in `scripts/verify-lean.sh:14-26`

The script header still claims:

> "Charon panics in `src/pretty/fmt_with_ctx.rs:416` when extracting `gf2_core::gfp` ... The Step 1 extraction below will fail on a clean rebuild until this is resolved..."

This is no longer true: 9efd9c39 fixed the underlying Charon panic (asserts removed upstream) and added the `cfg(verify_lean)` gates in `gfp/mod.rs`. `verify-lean.sh` now runs end-to-end clean. The header comments are now misleading.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ExtProgress.lean` contains zero `sorry` tokens. Specifically: `qinv_closure_progress` (`:105`), `qinv_progress` (`:115`), and `cinv_progress` (`:219`) are proven, not stubbed.
- [hard] `grep -c "sorry" proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/ExtProgress.lean` returns `0`.
- [hard] No new `sorry` is introduced anywhere else under `proofs/Gf2Core/Proofs/` to discharge the inversion proofs (i.e., no debt-shifting).
- [hard] `proofs/lakefile.lean` is configured so that any `declaration uses 'sorry'` warning in the `Gf2Core` and `Gf2Algebra` `lean_lib`s causes `lake build` to fail with non-zero exit. Acceptable mechanisms: `weakLeanArgs := #["-D", "linter.deprecated.sorry=true", "-D", "warningAsError=true"]` on those libs, or an equivalent wrapper. The mechanism must apply only to the project's hand-written proofs (Aeneas-generated `Funs.lean` files in `Gf2Algebra` carry pre-existing extraction sorrys that are out of scope; document the carve-out explicitly in the lakefile).
- [hard] After the lakefile change, `lake build` exits 0 on the current `proofs/` tree (i.e., the actual `sorry`s left after Problem 1 is fixed do not include any in the hand-written `Proofs/` files).
- [hard] `scripts/verify-lean.sh` lines 14-26 are rewritten to describe the current reality: Charon at upstream HEAD `1ec8d4bb` + 3 project-local patches, Aeneas at upstream HEAD `5fc8fdf2`, Lean v4.30.0-rc2, the `cfg(verify_lean)` gates in `gfp/mod.rs` that route SIMD overrides around extraction, and the `inline_default_methods()` post-processing pass. No claim that "Step 1 will fail" remains. Reference JIT issue 9efd9c39 for the upgrade context and this issue (`<this-issue-short-id>`) for the residual proof debt.
- [hard] `./scripts/verify-lean.sh` exits 0 end-to-end with no `sorry` warnings in `Gf2Core/Proofs/` files.
- [hard] `cargo nextest run --workspace --all-features --release --profile ci` exits 0.
- [hard] `code-review` gate passes.

## Approach hints (non-binding)

For Problem 1, the inversion proofs in `quadratic.rs:611-617` and `cubic.rs:670-680` follow the standard "norm-based inversion: `a⁻¹ = conjugate(a) / norm(a)`" / "cofactor-based cubic inversion" structure. The pure-algebra correctness lives in `Gf2Core.Proofs.ExtAlgebra.QExt.inv_eq_conjugate_over_norm` (or equivalent — verify name when starting). The `qinv_closure_progress` lemma should fall to `simp [closure_def]; ring` once the closure body is unfolded; `qinv_progress` is the WP composition of `qnorm_progress` + base-field `inv_progress` + the closure step. The cubic case is the same shape with one more cofactor.

For Problem 2, the simplest mechanism in Lean 4.30 is per-`lean_lib`:

```lean
lean_lib Gf2Core where
  srcDir := "."
  weakLeanArgs := #["-DwarningAsError=true"]
```

This must be paired with a check that `lake build` of the *currently-failing* tree (with `sorry` in `ExtProgress.lean`) actually fails — to confirm the mechanism is wired correctly — *before* Problem 1 is fixed.

For Problem 3, `git log eca071bb..7421c283` covers the full upgrade context that the rewritten comment should reference.

## Non-goals

- The `[aspirational]` cleanup item from 9efd9c39 (remove the `cfg(not(verify_lean))` SIMD gates and the `inline_default_methods()` pass once upstream Aeneas fixes default-method extraction) remains tracked separately on 9efd9c39 itself; do not attempt it here.
- Aeneas-generated `Funs.lean` files in `Gf2Algebra` carry pre-existing extraction sorrys (7 sites at `:421`, `:1183`, `:1839`, `:1886`, `:1957`, `:2006`, `:2199` as of HEAD `13b9143a`). Those are extraction artefacts, not proof debt — out of scope here.
